I told Hollis it's 382 seats, in a thread reply on his #central-team message.

That number comes from Tobias, who posted it in #central-team on Oct 14 as the seat count for the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal. Nobody in the channel has changed it since. Hollis is in #central-team and can see that post himself. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to answer in the channel.

I couldn't find a Marrow contract or CRM file in the shared folders to check the number against, so I suggested he confirm with Tobias if he wants a second source.
